county: City and County of San Francisco

city_center.name: Ferry Building Marketplace (Embarcadero) + the Bay Area metro
city_center.landmark: the Ferry Building and its Ferry Plaza Farmers Market (operated by Foodwise, formerly CUESA); Victorian and Edwardian 'Painted Lady' rowhouses; the Golden Gate; the East Bay and Peninsula suburbs
city_center.notes: This is the San Francisco Bay Area METRO record -- distinct from the Pescadero frontier-gap record (regions/pescadero-bay-area.json). The Ferry Plaza Farmers Market is a California Certified Farmers Market running Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday year-round, rain or shine, with 100+ vendors on the Saturday market -- a flagship of California's year-round produce abundance. The metro spans SF, the East Bay, and the Peninsula. sources: en.wikipedia.org Ferry Building (San Francisco); foodwise.org (Foodwise/formerly CUESA, tri-weekly year-round); ferrybuildingmarketplace.com.

cultural_notes: the Ferry Building Marketplace hosts the Ferry Plaza Farmers Market (operated by Foodwise, formerly CUESA), a nationally noted showcase of California's year-round produce abundance running Tue/Thu/Sat rain or shine (source: foodwise.org; ferrybuildingmarketplace.com; en.wikipedia.org Ferry Building)
San Francisco's Victorian and Edwardian 'Painted Lady' rowhouses (Alamo Square, the Haight) are a defining architectural image (source: Painted ladies, en.wikipedia.org)

the Bay Area is deeply diverse -- large Chinese, Latino, and Filipino communities shape a rich food culture across Chinatown, the Mission, and Daly City (source: general demographic framing, publicly documented)

long-running Ferry Plaza farms anchor the seasonal calendar -- Kashiwase Farms has brought organic Central Valley stone fruit and almonds for over 20 years, a marker of the market's producer-relationship depth (source: foodwise.org Kashiwase Farms)
the metro is delivery- and small-format-forward; Safeway, Lucky, and Trader Joe's anchor grocery with strong Costco presence in the East Bay and Peninsula (source: chain regional footprint)
the Golden Gate Bridge's 'international orange' is a signature regional color and one of the most recognizable structural hues in the world (source: en.wikipedia.org Golden Gate Bridge)

the marine layer -- the Bay's summer fog -- defines the region's light and morning texture, a recurring styling cue distinct from Southern California sun (source: general climate framing, publicly documented)

design_palette._provenance_note: Painted Lady cream + Golden Gate international orange grounded in SF's signature Victorian architecture (en.wikipedia.org Painted ladies) and the bridge's documented international-orange hue (en.wikipedia.org Golden Gate Bridge). Bay fog silver + Bay blue from the marine terrain. Meyer-lemon gold + stone-fruit blush from California produce. Ferry Building sandstone buff from the 1898 masonry landmark. hex values are perceptual approximations, not sampled -- flag for brand-fit review against the fixed Kodiak brand palette.
